title: Population growth, aging, and immigration
discussion_signal: The post links lower immigration, aging, population growth, public finance, and future labor supply, while arguing that AI and robotics could partly alter the adjustment path. Replies add disagreement over how much automation can substitute for demographic inflow, preserving a substantive counter-signal.
linked_research_question: How do immigration policy and demographic change alter labor supply, sector growth, public finance, and the perceived future of place?
limits: The post combines several external projections and interpretations
Audience reactions are not representative public opinion
Automation claims are speculative rather than causal evidence
